summary.zh: 去掉引擎的审批与沙箱限制：提示词注入 + 86 条引擎源码补丁。装完还差一步——说一句「重打补丁」把补丁层打上（补丁改的是引擎源码，安装流程打不了），打完重启引擎。
summary.en: Remove approval prompts and sandbox limits: prompt injection plus 86 engine source patches. One more step after install: say "repatch" so the plugin patches the engine (install cannot do it), then restart the engine.
